pullRequests.title: Fix RAC1 Gadgetron PDA crash with empty vendor stock
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: fix/archipelago-rac1-gadgetron-pda
pullRequests.body:
Summary
Prevents Ratchet & Clank 1 from crashing when the Archipelago Gadgetron PDA attempts to open a vendor menu with no purchasable rows.
Problem
The existing empty-vendor protection handles physical vendors, but the Gadgetron PDA opens the vendor menu remotely and bypasses the physical vendor interaction guard.
When no valid purchase rows are available, the game can crash while constructing or displaying the menu.
Changes

Hook Vendor_OpenMenu to intercept Gadgetron PDA menu opening.
Check…

pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: feature/lock-strafe-button
pullRequests.body:
Before: on foot the lock-strafe took both L2 and R2 from the game, so it could not run beside a mod that uses one of them (wrench-throw raises the wrench on R2).
After: a new setting, Strafe button: L2 or R2 (default, same as before), L2 only or R2 only. With one picked, the other reaches the game (L2 looks, R2 crouches) and other mods untouched.
How: the pad hook takes out and latches Hold only on the chosen bit (s_strafe_buttons, from rac1_strafe_button_bits in strafe.h). Version 1.2.0,…

commits.author: Veradictus

commits.headline: feat(difficulty): Going Commando's health pickups, 1.5.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The Health pickups slider and Chaos's Nanotech surge now play in Going
Commando too: rac2.moby.nanotech_ball.update (the nanotech orb's update, a
hook point on the three discs since SDK 1.14.3) gives the health its pieces
gave this tick scaled, carried over between pickups, and never past what the
game fills Ratchet to (his max health, 4 in a vehicle). An OpenRAC without
the hook point refuses the mod and names it.

commits.headline: fix(xbox-icons): Going Commando's title menus, 1.2.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The title (its main menu, Options and the memory card's questions) loads
only the large and the small font, with a palette of its own, and leaves the
third font's record zero. The mod asked for all three, so it never painted
the title's buttons. It now takes the fonts a set has (two at the title,
three in a level) and knows the title's pair, the same on the three discs.

commits.headline: fix(item-randomizer): Going Commando's vendor on every level, and a party's seed, 2.3.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The vendor's table is level data: each level's program brings the game's
own again, but the mod stocked it once a session, so only the first level
loaded sold the seed's weapons. It now writes the seed's levels at every
program load (seen on NTSC-U: 13 of the 16 back to the game's at the second
load).

In a party the host's seed counts in Going Commando too, as in Ratchet &
Clank: the host publishes its seed's code, each member plays that placement
until the party goes, and the vendor's table…

commits.headline: build: build against OpenRAC's SDK with Going Commando's item equip until SDK 1.14.4 is released
commits.author: Veradictus

commits.headline: fix(item-randomizer): a Going Commando giver's equip takes the reward, 2.3.1
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: Most givers put their item in Ratchet's hand right after giving it (Todano's Sheepinator pickup, the Tractor Beam, the Thermanator, the Swingshot, ...). Where the mod gave the place's reward in its stead, that equip still asked for the place's own item: the Sheepinator was held but never owned, in no list, and gone once put away. The mod now takes rac2.item.equip (SDK 1.14.4) and hands such an equip the reward, or nothing when the reward is not the player's to hold.

commits.headline: feat(item-randomizer): randomize only a game started with it, 2.4.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
New games only, a setting that is on by default: the mod changes a game
only when its save carries this seed's tag, so a playthrough started
without it (or with another seed) is never randomized partway. Every hook
hands the game its own routine then, the vendor keeps its table, and the
log says why once.

Going Commando: a new game gets the tag at its first tick in a level (New
Game unpacks the disc's starting save, whose clock is zero on all three
discs; every save on a card has the clock the…

commits.author: Veradictus

commits.headline: fix(multiplayer): shorten the pages' texts so nothing overflows, 0.12.1
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Every title, item, footer line, hint, question and notice is a few words
(Connected, Hosting, Party full, Leave party?), in all five languages.
The lobby and direct pages show addresses as list lines instead of titles,
the wrapped lines are narrower, and dynamic text is cut to the panels'
widths. A new multiplayer_words check measures every text against the
narrowest panel with a per-character width model and fails on overflow.

commits.headline: feat(multiplayer): keep parties to the game's family, 0.12.2
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
CREATE, LIST, FIND and JOIN end with the world family, so the server
lists and finds only this game's parties and refuses a join by code
into another game's with OTHER_GAME and that party's family. The
Refused page then says which game it is for ("For Ratchet & Clank 2"),
or a different disc. Browse also leaves out other games' parties
itself, for a server that lists them all; the check after joining
stays.
